Name: Mandalorian Helmets
Author: FoolishGent
Description:
Dyeable Mandalorian helmets with custom character paintjobs.

Included Helmets:
[b]Mandalorian Helmet[/b] - look just like THE Mando. Fully dyeable. 
[b]Mandalorian Scout Helmet[/b] - higher slit visor and scouter added. Fully dyeable.
[b]Boba Fett's Helmet [/b]
[b]Bo Katan's Helmet
Sabine Wren's Helmet[/b]

This mod is available for Fashion Sense or can be added directly into the game with Jsn Assets for sale at the Mouse Shop. Feel free to run both, they won't interfere with each other, but they are identical. It just depends on how you like to hat. Dying hats is only available through Fashion Sense.

THIS IS THE WAY:

[b][u]Requirements:
[/u][/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
Either [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense [/url]or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Jsn Assets[/url] depending on which version you download.

[b][u]Installation:
[/u][/b]1. Download the the zip
2. Unpack this Mod folder into the "Stardew Valley/Mods" folder created by SMAPI
3. Run the game with SMAPI
4. Rock that beskar
